<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">1:50 PM</text>
  <line x1="319" y1="17" x2="319" y2="13" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="324" y1="17" x2="324" y2="11" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="17" x2="329" y2="9" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="14" x2="347" y2="9" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="356" y="9" width="21" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="358" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#96E063"/>
  <rect x="378" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="28,67 21,74 28,81" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="45" y="80" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Time Zone</text>
  <text x="342" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="url(#brand)">t</text>
  <circle cx="359" cy="68" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="75" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="82" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="101" x2="370" y2="101" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Current zone section -->
  <text x="22" y="133" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">CURRENT TIME ZONE</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="148" width="350" height="142" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity=".05"/>
    <rect x="20" y="146" width="350" height="142" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="53" cy="181" r="22" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="181" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="181" x2="53" y2="175" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="181" x2="58" y2="184" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="88" y="178" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">Los Angeles</text>
  <text x="88" y="200" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Pacific Time · GMT-7</text>
  <text x="346" y="187" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">1:50</text>
  <text x="346" y="207" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PM</text>
  <line x1="42" y1="228" x2="348" y2="228" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="42" y="258" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your current location</text>
  <circle cx="341" cy="255" r="8" fill="#96E063"/>
  <polyline points="337,255 340,258 346,251" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Add new action -->
  <text x="22" y="328" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">ADDITIONAL TIME ZONES</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="342" width="350" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="366" x2="62" y2="366" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="359" x2="55" y2="373" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="371" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">ADD NEW</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Added zones -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="408" width="350" height="192" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity=".04"/>
    <rect x="20" y="406" width="350" height="192" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <circle cx="48" cy="440" r="17" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="440" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="440" x2="48" y2="435" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="440" x2="52" y2="442" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="77" y="438" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">New York</text>
  <text x="77" y="458" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Eastern Time · GMT-4</text>
  <text x="342" y="447" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">4:50 PM</text>
  <line x1="40" y1="480" x2="350" y2="480" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="48" cy="513" r="17" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="513" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="513" x2="48" y2="508" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="513" x2="52" y2="515" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="77" y="511" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">London</text>
  <text x="77" y="531" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Greenwich Mean Time · GMT+1</text>
  <text x="342" y="520" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">9:50 PM</text>
  <line x1="40" y1="553" x2="350" y2="553" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="40" y="580" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Swipe left on a city to remove it</text>

  <!-- Footer navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="768" width="390" height="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="768" x2="390" y2="768" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,790 50,781 61,790 61,803 54,803 54,795 46,795 46,803 39,803" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="50" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="790" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="128,784 130,788 135,789" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="128" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="205" cy="790" r="10" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <polyline points="199,790 203,794 211,786" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="205" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FE3675">Settings</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="282" cy="787" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="282" cy="800" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="282" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="337" y="783" width="13" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="340,795 338,800 344,796" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="789" r="1" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="789" r="1" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="344" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Chats</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="166" y="835" width="58" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
</svg>
